scripts.api: cd backend && uv run alembic upgrade head && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload --reload-dir app
scripts.seed: cd backend && uv run alembic upgrade head && uv run python -m app.seed
scripts.api:prod: cd backend && uv run alembic upgrade head && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --workers 2 --no-access-log
scripts.web:prod: npm --prefix web run build && npm --prefix web run start -- -p 3000 -H 0.0.0.0
scripts.stop: for port in 8000 3000 3443; do pids=$(lsof -tiTCP:$port -sTCP:LISTEN); [ -n "$pids" ] && kill -9 $pids; done; echo stopped
